text_simplified: Tarbiyah (upbringing) of children is a tremendous responsibility, and it must be done with sincere intention for the sake of Allah, the Exalted. The goal should not be limited to this world alone; rather, seeking knowledge and tarbiyah should be for the purpose of attaining the pleasure of Allah and the Hereafter. Some parents focus only on worldly certificates and positions, and this is a mistake, for the true reward lies in raising children with good akhlaq (character) and deen. The tarbiyah of daughters, in particular, requires great care and noble nurturing.
